entry_state: Complete synthetic companies demonstrate the promised chain, while real disclosures constrain it without identifying all histories. Source readings, conditional calculations and review proposals retain separate identities; the representation chapter must now formalize those distinctions.
exit_state: Assertions preserve source, measurement, time, perimeter and review meaning. Coverage, mapping and temporal selection are explicit procedures, and accepted transcription remains distinct from admissible accounting use. The next example tests these distinctions on a faithfully preserved but wrong source reference.
findings: The chapter returns to Northstar and Apple before defining records, so the schema follows already demonstrated financial needs. Document, semantic and simulation coverage keep different denominators.

Mapping composition requires compatible contexts and disjoint partitions; supersession requires eligible assertions rather than storage recency. Extraction, interpretation, model admission and accounting eligibility remain separate decisions.
Tables and continuation headers are readable. No new confirmed defect in pages62–67; implementation of these proposed procedures remains separate.
